description: List InterPro domain architectures containing the supplied Pfam or InterPro domains. Order and repeated domains are preserved; exact matching requires the given order and excludes extra domains. Pass an ida_id to interpro_find_proteins_by_domain as architectureId with one of the architecture’s domains as accession to list matching proteins.

exact.description: Require exactly the supplied domains in order. Implies ordered.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `entry_withdrawn`: InterPro reports HTTP 410 for the requested record. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor is malformed, belongs to another selection, or is rejected upstream. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: The shared fifty-second budget expires while fetching the architecture page. `upstream_shape_invalid`: Upstream JSON, row shape, or continuation is incompatible. `upstream_response_too_large`: An upstream response exceeds 4 MiB. `upstream_rejected`: InterPro returns an unhandled redirect or client rejection. `upstream_unavailable`: InterPro has a network or server failure; HTTP 501 is not retryable. `upstream_timeout`: InterPro returns HTTP 408/504 or an attempt exceeds its deadline. `upstream_rate_limited`: InterPro returns HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
